The finmap.org MCP server provides comprehensive historical data from the US, UK, Russian and Turkish stock exchanges. Access sectors, tickers, company profiles, market cap, volume, value, and trade counts, as well as treemap and histogram visualizations
FinBrain MCP server: expose FinBrain datasets to AI agents (Claude, VSCode etc.) via SDK-first tools. Runs locally with each user's own FinBrain API key.
NYSE/NASDAQ trading calendar — holidays, early closes, trading-day navigation, DST-aware is-market-open. Zero dependencies.
Python module to get real-time stock data from Google Finance API
Free AI Stock Reports Delivered Daily — Wall Street-grade analysis for US, China & HK stocks. 100% free.

YQL-finance is a simple and fast Python API https://developer.yahoo.com/yql/console/. The API returns closing prices of stocks for the current period of time and current stock ticker (e.g. APPL, GOOGL). Stock prices: NASDAQ, SP&500, DAX, etc.
